# PR Rework — review-thread fixes + CI red (gh-1825 follow-up)

## Issues/Notes

**CI red (validation run 40263555278):** 3 failures in
`flutter_app/test/file_browser_test.dart` — all "ChatScreen integration"
tests died with `Bad state: agentNetwork before initialize()` from
`_ChatScreenState._interceptDapSubmit` (chat_screen.dart:410) on every
composer send. Root cause is in this PR's diff: the new
`plaintextStorage:` argument evaluated `widget.service.agentNetwork`
**eagerly** when building the interceptor call, so any send through a
`ChatScreen` whose `AgentService` was never `initialize()`d (widget tests,
minimal hosts) threw mid-`_send`. The probe now builds lazily
(`() => widget.service.agentNetwork.enrollmentUsesPlaintextStorage()`); it
is only invoked after an enrollment paste was actually recognized and the
join succeeded. Local repro before the fix: the same 3 tests failed
identically; after the fix all pass.

Owned CI violations (`ci_violations.json` reported `owned: 0`, all three
rows `ownership: unknown`; they are in code paths this PR changed, so they
were fixed, not disputed):

- `Flutter app tests (shard 1/2): 2008 passed, 3 failed` — **fixed** by the
  lazy `plaintextStorage` probe in `chat_screen.dart` (see above).
- `Flutter app tests (shard 1/2): Process completed with exit code 1` — **fixed**
  (same root cause; the shard is green once the 3 tests pass).
- `Quality gate: Process completed with exit code 1` — **fixed** (same root
  cause; the gate aggregates the flutter-tests leg).

## Approach

TDD per thread: failing/regression test first, minimal fix, then the
focused suites, then the full root suite. All five open review threads have
a targeted reply in `outputs/review_replies.json`.

1. **IMPORTANT — failed realtime decode (network_session.dart:554):**
   `_onEnvelope` now returns the swallowing `state._realtimeTail` instead of
   the raw `operation`, matching the containment comment. Note (also in the
   thread reply): the chained tail's `onError` listener already marked the
   rejection handled at the Dart Future level, so no unhandled async error
   actually reached the zone — verified with a probe; the change makes the
   returned future honestly safe to await from any caller. Regression test
   pins: no message for the corrupt envelope, no unhandled error, later
   arrivals still append in order.
2. **SUGGESTION — `dispose()` no-op memoization (fah_hub_plugin.dart:278):**
   a no-op dispose taken before `register()` now re-arms once `_scoped`
   exists (`_disposeWasNoOp`), real cleanups stay idempotent, and the boot
   seed path bails when `_dispose != null` — a disposed host never reseeds
   plaintext keys.
3. **SUGGESTION — post-resolution `_fail` skips teardown
   (fah_runapp.dart:1129):** new awaited `failAfterPlugins` wrapper runs
   `teardownPlugins()` before the usage exit; all six post-resolution
   `_fail` sites route through it. Wiring pinned in
   `bin_main_wiring_reg_test.dart` (teardown count 6 → 7; only direct
   `_fail(` after the seam is the wrapper's inner call).
4. **SUGGESTION — pid-reuse pins the overlay (fah_dap_scoped.dart:545):**
   guard sweep now requires pid-alive **and** a fresh mtime (24 h bound;
   every boot rewrites the guard, so live guards are fresh). A recycled pid
   with a stale guard is reclaimed. Keep-on-doubt semantics unchanged
   (mtime probe failure = fresh; delete failure = keep).
5. **SUGGESTION — platform override leak (chat_composer_test.dart:664):**
   `addTearDown` restore added; the in-body reset is kept because
   `flutter_test` verifies foundation debug vars are unset before tearDowns
   run (`addTearDown`-only trips `debugAssertAllFoundationVarsUnset`).

Also fixed two pre-existing analyzer infos in touched test files
(`use_null_aware_elements`, `unnecessary_brace_in_string_interps`) so
`dart analyze --fatal-infos` stays clean on the 3.47 SDK.

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/lib/network/network_session.dart` — return the swallowing
  `_realtimeTail` from `_onEnvelope`.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` — lazy `plaintextStorage`
  probe (CI root cause).
- `bin/fah_hub_plugin.dart` — re-arming `dispose()`, `_disposeWasNoOp`,
  disposed-host seed guard in `_connectWithScopedBoot`.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — `failAfterPlugins` wrapper; six post-resolution
  `_fail` sites converted.
- `bin/fah_dap_scoped.dart` — `_overlayGuardMaxAge` (24 h) + `_guardIsFresh`
  in the guard sweep.
- `flutter_app/test/network/network_session_test.dart` — failed-decode
  containment regression test.
- `flutter_app/test/chat_composer_test.dart` — `addTearDown` platform
  restore (+ kept in-body reset).
- `test/hub/hub_plugin_host_test.dart` — dispose-before-register regression
  test; pre-existing null-aware-element lint fix.
- `test/hub/dap_scoped_memberships_test.dart` — stale-recycled-guard
  regression test; pre-existing interpolation lint fix.
- `test/bin_main_wiring_reg_test.dart` — teardown wiring count 6 → 7 and
  post-seam `_fail` routing assertions.

## Test Coverage

- RED confirmed before each fix: the new tests failed (or the CI failure
  reproduced locally 3/3 for file_browser).
- Root: `dart test` — full suite run against the final tree (see final run
  note); focused: `bin_main_wiring_reg_test.dart`,
  `hub_plugin_host_test.dart`, `dap_scoped_memberships_test.dart` — 41/41.
- Flutter app: `network_session_test.dart` + `chat_composer_test.dart` +
  `file_browser_test.dart` — the 3 previously CI-failing ChatScreen
  integration tests pass; `chat_composer_test.dart` 17/17 after the
  tearDown refinement.
- Analyzers: `dart analyze bin test` — no issues;
  `flutter analyze` — no issues in the changed files (129 pre-existing
  infos in untouched web/tool files remain).
- `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` — clean on all changed files.

# Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage
          test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart
          test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
===
tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
